coverage.reason: HUD and own-profile heraldry must keep the last confirmed visual during delayed sign-in and reconnect, without inventing a default for a clan whose shield has not loaded. The new real-browser test exercises delayed and repeated subscriptions, actual page reload, display-only cache scoping across accounts/realm/shard/clan, stale callbacks, fresh edits, removed clans, corrupt/blocked storage and the one-shot load fallback. Inspect screenshots and hit/size geometry at desktop 1440x900 and landscape 844x390/568x320. Existing clan notification lifecycle coverage protects applications, role/session guards, badges, heraldry editing, revision ordering and v1 compatibility affected by shared rendering/subscription paths. Heraldry and clan validators preserve saved renderer/schema and membership integration. No backend, authoritative membership/reward rules, world data or styles change; no emulator suite is needed for this presentation-only change.
